samples.description: Complete-case historical training rows for the Table 1 Panel B Eq. (1) one-, two-, and three-year earnings forecasts; each exact predictor/outcome pair is repeated only in its eligible rolling origin years.

assumptions: Unweighted pooled OLS implements the paper's pooled cross-sectional regression description.
The ten-year rolling sample window is applied to realized outcome years t-10 through t-1.
Newey-West lag 3 is used because the paper does not report the bandwidth.

limitations: The paper does not specify the rolling-window endpoint convention, dividend mnemonic, primary-link selection rule, or Newey-West lag; the best-effort choices are documented in design.md.
Source support starts at 1963, shorter than a literal ten-year window for the earliest origin years; early origins use available historical rows and never post-origin outcomes.
Provider currency tables begin in the local 1980s vintage; non-USD monetary fields without exact, unique, positive dated rates remain missing while USD observations remain eligible.
The installed xtfmb lag option supplies individual coefficient HAC standard errors but zeroes off-diagonal covariances, so joint HAC inference is not reported.
